extra_quotes: Using ultrafast stroboscopic optical scattering microscopy (stroboSCAT), we image spatiotemporal evolution of energy carriers with picosecond resolution, simultaneously resolving heat and charge transport in bulk black phosphorus and exciton transport in the monolayer.

To understand the experimentally measured diﬀusion, we perform ﬁrst principles calculations of the exciton dispersion39, exciton-phonon scattering rates40–43, and exciton transport within a Boltzmann transport equation approach43–45.

A similar analysis targeting the heat contrast recovers diﬀusion coeﬃcients on the order of ~1 cm2/s along both axes (Figures S10-12), but the uncertainty precludes obtaining a reliable anisotropy ratio.
The simulated process is not a full description of diﬀusion, since it only includes exciton-phonon scattering and neglects exciton population eﬀects
